title: Replication package - Measuring what registries miss: field-level coverage of researcher certification against open bibliographic data
description: Full pipeline and data for measuring field-level coverage of a national researcher registry (RENACYT, Peru) against OpenAlex: harvest of 186,136 Peru-affiliated works (2015-2026), aggregation into 191,089 author profiles, three-tier name linkage, and coverage analysis with Wilson confidence intervals for 204 subfields. Companion to a manuscript submitted to the Journal of Informetrics.
